convention: tay_trai/tay_phai, chan_trai/chan_phai theo phia nhan vat (nhan vat nhin ra man hinh). z: so thap = ve sau (sau), so cao = ve truoc. pivot: [x,y] theo toa do canvas goc.

parts.name: chan_trai
parts.note: Chan trai NV (phai anh), giay den. Pivot hong. Di lai: xoay quanh hong.

parts.name: chan_phai
parts.note: Chan phai NV (trai anh), giay den. Pivot hong. Di lai: xoay quanh hong.

parts.name: phu_kien_kiem
parts.note: Kiem deo cheo sau lung (chuoi + vo). z sau than. Pivot chuoi kiem. Rut kiem: truot kiem ra khoi vo.

parts.name: than
parts.note: Ao trang tu vai den chan. Pivot giua nguc. Cui chao: xoay nhe.

parts.name: tay_trai
parts.note: Tay trai NV (phai anh), tay ao rong. Pivot vai. Vay tay: xoay quanh vai.

parts.name: tay_phai
parts.note: Tay phai NV (trai anh), tay ao rong. Pivot vai. Vay tay: xoay quanh vai.

parts.name: dau
parts.note: Mat + bui toc. Pivot co. Gat/lac dau: xoay quanh co.

parts.name: phu_kien_tram
parts.note: Tram cai toc ngoc + tua rua. Pivot chan tram. Lac nhe theo dau.
